state.row_3_19_done_when: Masks (add, subtract, intersect, difference; feather; expansion), clip groups, alpha and luma mattes and trim start/end/offset render on the GPU and match CPU references; the scene contract's trim values are honoured (they are silently ignored today); an unsupported combination refuses by name.
user_decisions_15_nov: Masks live on each object (ObjectBase.masks); done and committed as increment 1.
Clip groups: GroupObject.clipChildId names one child whose coverage clips the group's other children; the clip child is not drawn itself.
Masks and clip shapes are drawn at prepare and are static for now; animating them refuses by name.

Track mattes (next increment): ObjectBase.trackMatte {sourceId, mode alpha|alphaInverted|luma|lumaInverted}; each frame the compositor renders the matte source into its own tile target and the consumer sample is multiplied by the matte there.
facts: Every drawing object is drawn once at prepare into its own layer texture (Vello coverage, float colour); per frame the GPU compositor only warps (affine: position, rotation, scale) and blends those textures, with the object effective opacity. Animatable properties: opacity, x, y, zDepth, rotation, rotationX, rotationY, scaleX, scaleY, scaleZ, width, height.
Groups paint nothing. An object's effective transform, opacity and visibility multiply down from its ancestors (a group at opacity 0.5 halves every descendant).
The CPU reference evaluates every frame from the document too, so it can draw a clip shape at its per-frame position exactly as the GPU does.

Implementing clips through the per-frame matte target that track mattes need anyway means the clip shape is still drawn at prepare (its layer texture) and is only warped per frame, like every other layer; a clip child or clip group that moves or fades then renders correctly instead of refusing, with no extra refusal code path.

clip_mechanism.instructions: How should a clip group be rendered?

criteria.per_frame_matte: As an alpha matte: the clip child's prepared layer is warped each frame into a matte target and every other descendant's sample is multiplied by its alpha there; a moving or fading clip renders correctly and nothing about animation refuses. Report the deviation from the static decision to the user.
criteria.static_refuse: Bake the clip coverage at prepare and refuse by name any animation channel on the clip child, the clip group or the group's ancestors, as the user's decision literally says.

clip_opacity.instructions: Which opacity does the clip child's coverage carry?

criteria.own_opacity: Only the clip child's own opacity: the group's and ancestors' opacity already reach the clipped children through effective opacity, so counting it in the clip as well would apply it twice.
criteria.effective_opacity: The clip child's effective opacity (its own times its ancestors').
criteria.ignore_opacity: None: the clip is the clip child's shape coverage at full strength, whatever its opacity.

clip_hidden.instructions: The clip child has visible = false (it is never drawn itself in any case). What should the group do?

criteria.clip_still_applies: The clip still applies: visibility of a clip child only affects drawing it, which never happens (After Effects track mattes behave so).
criteria.clip_off: The clip is switched off and the other children draw unclipped (Figma hides the mask layer this way).
criteria.refuse: Refuse by name: a hidden clip child is ambiguous.

clip_scope.instructions: Which objects does a clip group clip?

criteria.all_descendants: Every descendant of the group except the clip child, whatever its draw order; a nested clip group multiplies its own clip with the outer one.
criteria.above_clip_only: Only children drawn above the clip child in draw order (Figma/Photoshop clipping).

clip_child_kind.instructions: What may the clip child be?

criteria.drawing_kinds: A drawing object (rect, ellipse, line, shape, text, image) with its fill, stroke, masks and effects; a group, layer, camera, light, marker, mesh or paint clip child refuses by name, as does a clipChildId that is not one of the group childIds.
criteria.any_object: Any object, a nested group included (its composite becomes the clip).

needs_user.instructions: Must the user approve this before implementation?

criteria.true: Yes, a recorded user decision would change.
